Scientific, Lean, and source-grounded preflight client-tool loops now request the Anthropic prompt caching already used by Theory workspaces; unsupported providers retain the existing capability fallback.
No task answer, statistical threshold, Lean grammar rule, tactic rule, repair worker, or post-runtime scheduler was added.

Exact Haiku performed seven formal-source searches, eleven declaration inspections, two complete Lean submissions, and two raw local Lean checks before reporting a typed target-modeling gap. The runtime then incorrectly reopened an already accepted Simulation lane because the accepted simulation manifest ID was absent from deferred architect context; dd5c36c4 fixes that identity propagation and a deterministic integration test proves the post-Formalizer transition now goes to Critic.
diagnosis.sequential_anytime_bernoulli: Independent theory-to-execution preflight rejected the initial theory and two same-TheoryDeveloper revisions before any code execution. The first revision changed notes rather than authoritative artifacts. The second changed authoritative artifacts but promoted unsupported empirical numbers after failed scratch runs and still lacked justified discretization, mixing, integrability, and stopping-rule conditions. The gate correctly failed closed; dd5c36c4 strengthens the model instruction without relaxing review.
diagnosis.formalizer_capacity: The Formalizer had task-relevant StatInference retrieval and raw Lean feedback, so v418 does not support adding theorem-specific retrieval or a repair worker. Its final type mismatch may reflect a genuine missing target representation or insufficient Haiku mathematical synthesis; it is not kernel proof evidence.
